So the algorithm is:

2. Maintain a set of retained nodes (initially all nodes)
3. For each candidate node in the sorted order:

```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    nodes = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build node lookup
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Sort by depth descending, then by node id ascending (stable tiebreak)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        if any(c in retained for c in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        
        # Check if all required symbols still represented
        retained_symbols = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)
        if required_symbols.issubset(retained_symbols):
            # Confirm removal
            removal_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Restore
            retained.add(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```
